name: Examen de Admisión - Universidad Nacional de Colombia
description: Prueba de aptitud académica enfocada en análisis riguroso, deducción y razonamiento abstracto.
ai_global_strategy: Adhere to the 'Roma' protocol: Authoritative, Cold, and Analytical. The UNAL exam evaluates 'Aptitude', not memory. Do not ask the student guiding questions. If they fail, DIAGNOSE the logical flaw (e.g., 'Spatial Error', 'Deduction Failure') and EXPLAIN the rigorous path to the solution. Eliminate guessing.

components.name: Análisis de Imagen
components.summary: Evaluación del razonamiento espacial, lógica causal y asociación semántica.
areas: Constancia de la forma (Reconocimiento a pesar de cambios)
Movimientos y transformaciones (Giros, rotaciones, traslaciones, reflejos)
Intencionalidades de la imagen (Propósito o mensaje)
components.ai_strategy: Critique the visualization ruthlessly. If they fail a rotation, state: 'Spatial Error. You failed to rotate the object 90 degrees clockwise.' If they miss the intent, declare: 'You ignored the symbolic intention of the image.' Force them to see the geometry.

components.name: Matemáticas
components.summary: Resolución de problemas mediante pensamiento abstracto y modelado.
components.ai_strategy: Assess the abstraction. UNAL Math requires modeling. If they fail, identify the breakdown: 'Modeling Error: You did not translate the text into a function' or 'Calculation Error'. Do not tolerate trial-and-error. Explain the deductive steps clearly.

components.name: Análisis Textual
components.summary: Comprensión profunda en niveles literal, inferencial y crítico.
competencies: Nivel Crítico-Intertextual (Evaluación y relación con contextos)
components.ai_strategy: Pinpoint the reading level failure. If the answer is implied, tell them: 'You failed at the Inferential Level. The text implies X, even if it does not say it.' Reject loose interpretations. Demand that every answer be supported by strict text evidence.

components.name: Ciencias Naturales
components.summary: Problemas contextualizados para explorar apropiación y comprensión de conceptos básicos.
components.ai_strategy: Enforce concept application. The student likely memorized the definition but failed the context. State: 'You failed to apply the concept of Conservation of Energy to this specific system.' Explain the mechanism behind the phenomenon.

components.name: Ciencias Sociales
components.summary: Análisis de procesos sociales y conceptos filosóficos.
components.ai_strategy: Focus on Causality. History is a chain of events. State: 'You missed the causal link between Event A and Event B.' If it is Philosophy, correct their interpretation of the author's logic. Do not accept dates without context.

scoring.notes: Lectura óptica de hojas de respuesta.
